name: Web Search
description: Cindy's built-in web search plugin: Cindy AI by default, or your own Brave / Tavily / DeepSeek / AnySearch API key. Keys are configured in the plugin details, encrypted locally, injected only to declared hosts. AnySearch works keyless; opt in in the plugin details first.
whenToUse: Use this plugin to search the public web, research a topic, find web pages, or check current information. Cindy AI is used by default; you can also configure a Brave, Tavily, DeepSeek or AnySearch key in the Web Search plugin details.

search_web.description: Search the public web; returns { provider, results: [{ title, url, snippet }] }. Default: Cindy AI; optional Brave, Tavily, DeepSeek or AnySearch. Queries: at most 2000 characters; DeepSeek: 128 Unicode characters, never truncated. DeepSeek prefers summary for snippets, bills successful requests and does not fetch full pages. AnySearch works without a key (anonymous quota, accessible in mainland China, lower rate) or with an AnySearch API key; anonymous usage requires opting in first by selecting AnySearch as the BYO provider or saving a key in the plugin details, otherwise NOT_CONFIGURED is returned; snippet falls back to content when missing. Failures preserve Host errorCode; relay message to the user and configure missing keys in plugin details. No automatic retries or provider fallback.
